what_is.title: What is Etraydi?
what_is.description: Etraydi is a specialized trading simulation platform built for educational purposes. We provide a safe haven for beginners and enthusiasts to explore the world of finance, track virtual portfolios, and test strategies without any real financial risk. Our mission is to democratize financial education through immersive practice.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is Etraydi a real trading platform?
faq.a1: No, Etraydi is a trading simulator designed for educational purposes. All trades use virtual funds.
faq.a2: Etraydi is 100% free to download and use for all educational activities.
faq.q3: Can I withdraw my virtual earnings?
faq.a3: No. Virtual earnings are for simulation purposes only and have no real-world monetary value.

footer.description: Empowering traders through risk-free simulation and financial education.
footer.disclosure_body: Etraydi is a specialized trading simulator designed EXCLUSIVELY for educational and entertainment purposes. This application DOES NOT facilitate real-money transactions, provide brokerage services, or offer professional investment advice. All trading activities, results, and portfolios within the app are strictly virtual and do not reflect real-world market capital or performance. We do not solicit investments nor facilitate any form of financial withdrawals.
